text:
Samira H.: Heads up — tried the Rust quickstart (starter crate) on a fresh SSO/SCIM org and the first API call returns 403 billing_required, but the billing page suggests accepting Terms of Service first. The error text: "billing_required: accept_terms_required". Admin can't find any place to accept TOS in console. Anyone seen an "accept terms" gate for new orgs?
Ethan (devex): interesting, that's a slightly different gating flow than the usual payment-method-only case. Can you paste the exact curl/snippet you used and the exact error?
Samira H.: running the local example shim that talks to the env var token:
```bash
cargo run --example quickstart -- --api-key sk-dev-zzz --model rw-mini-1
```
Response body:
```json
{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace 981234: accept_terms_required","help_url":"https://console.redwood.example/orgs/981234/onboarding"}}
```
Samira H.: the console link goes to onboarding but there's just a banner: "Contact your admin to complete onboarding" and no accept-terms checkbox. Admin is the SSO owner.
Nate (sdk): we added a new policy for some jurisdictions where TOS acceptance is required before enabling billing UI. The console should surface an accept-terms CTA for org owners, but it only shows up when `org.onboard_state` = `needs_terms` — SCIM flows sometimes set `provisioned` which skips that screen.
Nate (sdk): also note SDK quickstart shows a generic 403 message; we might improve it to include the `help_url` field so quickstart runners can render a helpful link.
Samira H.: ok that matches — our SCIM payload probably put org into `provisioned`. Is there a temporary path for admins to accept terms or flip onboard_state?
Ethan (devex): workaround for internal admins: use the internal accept route `https://console.redwood.example/orgs/981234/onboarding/accept-terms?force=true` (internal-only) which will surface the TOS modal and record acceptance. After that the billing add-card CTA appears as normal. Not ideal for customers but ok for internal testing.
support-bot: Created ticket SUP-9203: "SCIM-provisioned orgs missing accept-terms CTA causing billing_required on quickstarts" assigned to infra-provisioning + console-ux.
legal-bot: Note: TOS acceptance must be recorded with audit metadata (ip, user, timestamp). Ensure internal force route still logs those fields.
Nate (sdk): on SDK side i'll add code so the quickstart prints the `help_url` when the response includes it and a small hint: "If your org was SSO/SCIM-provisioned, ask an admin to visit the onboarding URL or contact infra." I'll open PR today.
Ethan (devex): action items: 1) Add a short troubleshooting note to the Rust quickstart README about `accept_terms_required` and the internal force link; 2) Add FAQ entry mapping `billing_required` variants (`accept_terms_required`, `needs_billing_admin`, `enterprise_restricted`) to walkbooks; 3) Request infra backfill to flip `onboard_state` to `needs_terms` when SCIM payload contains `requires_terms=true` or `initial_admin=true`.
Samira H.: workaround worked — admin used the force accept-terms link, accepted, then added a card and the quickstart returned 200. Thanks.
Ethan (devex): i'll update the quickstart and the onboarding FAQ, and add an analytics ping to capture `billing_required::accept_terms_required` so we can measure frequency.
Samira H.: thanks folks — please tag me when the README PR lands so i can update our internal tutorial. Closing thread after docs lands. :rocket:
